Header: Spodoptera mauritia (Boisduval) หนอนกระทู้กล้า

Prevention: Control weeds around rice field before planting because they are alternate hosts.
Pre-planting: plough soil and stubble, flooding the filed for 1 month to damage pupae
Monitoring: Make homemade light traps and place around field to monitor for adults
Field survey: observe damage of rice by direct counting (15 days to harvest).
ETL: if leaf damage more than 15% use direct control
If many are found, adults should be controlled before they become highly abundant
Direct Control: Use a sweep net to catch adults then destroy them
Use a sticky board with oil next to home light to attract adults
Restrictions: Don’t apply insecticides in the first 40 days after sowing or transplanting.
Don’t apply granular insecticide, don’t mix insecticides, don’t use 36 chemicals in the
RD list (will kill natural enemies and cause resistance)
